title: Saved reviewer session continuation
description: Verify exact-session startup and delta task execution on retained reviewer runs through their owning gateway, plus exclusive source transfer and prior-report preservation. Publication stays disabled.

retained-runners.intent: Read the owning gateway's real runner receipts and task progress to prove two exact saved conversations execute their delta-scoped successor tasks.

source-transfer.intent: Reuse a stopped review's source path, preserve its reports, reject old-owner cleanup, and retry the same transfer.

unsupported-continuation.intent: An authenticated WARM request must obey a declared unsupported capability and keep its exact delta and earlier finding in a fresh COLD session trace, without launching a provider.
